data.desc: SmartStop (NYSE: SMA) is a self-managed REIT with a fully integrated operations team of more than 1,000 self-storage professionals focused on growing the SmartStop Self Storage brand. SmartStop, through its indirect subsidiary SmartStop REIT Advisors, LLC, also sponsors other self-storage programs, and through its Managed Platform offers third-party management services in the U.S. and Canada. As of October 6, 2026, SmartStop has an owned or managed portfolio of approximately 475 operating properties in 36 states, the District of Columbia, and Canada, comprising over 285,000 units and approximately 36.7 million rentable square feet. SmartStop and its affiliates own or manage 70 operating self-storage properties across five provinces in Canada, which total approximately 59,000 units and 6 million rentable square feet.
